FAQs

Yes. Our ceramic nonstick coating, Thermakind™, is mainly comprised of a sand derivative, water, and alcohol, and it's made without PFAS (including PTFEs and PFOAs), lead and cadmium.

All Our Place cookware is made without PFAS, lead, or cadmium and undergoes rigorous third-party testing, whether you choose ceramic nonstick, titanium, or enameled cast iron.

Let the pan cool before washing, hand wash with warm water and a soft sponge, and cook on low to medium heat. Our guide to cleaning ceramic cookware has the full routine.

Yes. Ceramic nonstick cookware is oven safe up to 450°F, Titanium Pro up to 1000°F (1000ºF for Chrome versions and up to 750ºF for Gold versions), and our Cast Iron Always Pan® up to 500°F without the lid.
